This petition is filed by petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 3 under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C for quashing the criminal proceedings in C.C.11002/2022 pending on the file of 1st Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Rural Court, Bengaluru and charge sheeted for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of I.P.C and Section 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
During the pendency of the petition, both petitioner and respondent No.2 appeared through their counsels and filed a joint compromise application along with affidavit under Section 320 read with Section 482 of I.P.C for seeking permission to compound the offence.
opennyai_summary.decision:
